questions.stem_text: Herberg's (1955) study of religion in America suggested that:

options.A: ethnic minorities practised religion to achieve social acceptance in the culture
options.B: mainstream faiths were becoming increasingly identified with national identity
options.C: the moral teachings of the main religions were becoming relatively similar

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - all of the above

questions.stem_text: The social construction of childhood can be traced back to:

options.C: new consumer goods for children, such as clothes, toys and books

questions.stem_text: The tripartite system used the 11+ exam to select pupils for:

options.A: popular schools that lay outside their catchment area
options.C: grammar, technical, and secondary modern schools

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - grammar, technical, and secondary modern schools

questions.stem_text: The effect of the Internet upon the public sphere has been to:

options.A: repress it, by promoting only the interests of elite groups
options.B: revive it, by reaffirming a commitment to freedom of speech
options.C: reproduce it, by emphasizing face-to-face contact with peer groups
options.D: replace it with a superior form of communication

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - revive it, by reaffirming a commitment to freedom of speech
